observations: Three photos show two car headlamps placed side by side on a blue plastic stool.
The headlamps have a modern, angular design with LED daytime running lights and clear lens covers.
The housing appears to be black plastic with some visible wear, scratches, and minor damage, especially on the edges and mounting points.
The headlamps are not mounted on a vehicle; they are shown separately, suggesting they are used or removed parts.
No visible branding or model markings are readable on the headlamps in any photo.
The background includes a metal railing, a red wall, and a tiled floor, indicating an outdoor or balcony setting.
The seller claims they are from a 2017 Toyota RAV4 and include a charger, but no charger is visible in any photo.

claims.claim: First owned/used Toyota Rav4 led headlamp
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model markings on the headlamps in any photo to confirm they are from a Toyota RAV4.
No visible VIN, model plate, or other identifier to confirm the year. The design is consistent with 2017 RAV4 headlamps, but not confirmable from photos alone.
No charger is visible in any of the three photos. The claim cannot be supported by visual evidence.
